meta.title: Druid data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60, vs level 63 training dummy): Feral Cat, Feral Bear (tank), Balance
meta.scope: Shapeshifting and resource rules (Energy, Rage, Mana), Shifting Power, every ability a level-60 druid uses against a raid boss in Cat Form, Dire Bear Form and Moonkin/caster form, procs, what an attacking dummy needs for a bear tank, talent trees, the sims' builds, priority lists and default stats. Restoration is out of scope (its talents are listed only because talent strings need them).
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves, Wowhead Forever tooltips), by Blizzard (deep dive, development notes), or measured in game on the beta. Most beta measurements were taken at levels 8-30; level-60 values are datamined or extrapolated unless noted.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims with no Forever source yet, or where the two sims disagree. Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit 9c05fc890b (2026-10-09). Engine: wowsims/classic + ElliotWood/Forever. Uses the current (post-1-October, client 70170/70291) druid tree with Shifting Power; Tiger's Fury is gone.
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). Engine: wowsims/forever. Carries the beta client spell rows (client 1.60.1.70124). Its druid code and talent tree predate the 1 October Feral rework: it still has Tiger's Fury and King of the Jungle and no Shifting Power, and its Omen of Clarity rate (2 PPM) comes from beta logs.

practiceYardSummary: Cat: Energy 100, 10 per second smooth. All cat attacks have a 1.0 s GCD. Tiger's Fury no longer exists. The new Shifting Power (Feral talent, Cat Form only) costs 55% of base mana (684 at 60), gives +40 Energy, 16 s cooldown (8 s with Improved Shifting Power 2/2, 7 s with Howling Idol), 1.0 s GCD, cannot be used at full Energy; Wolfshead Helm adds 5 Energy.

Cat finishers: Rip (30 Energy, 6 ticks over 12 s, ticks can crit and ignore armor) and Ferocious Bite (35 Energy, then spends ALL remaining Energy at 2.7 damage each). Builders refund 80% when avoided. Shred 60 Energy (42 with Shredding Attacks 3/3), behind only.

Bear: Rage is normalized in game like the warrior's: about 11.25 Rage per landed white swing (4.5 x the 2.5 s bear swing), +100% on a crit since 8 Oct, nothing on miss/dodge/parry. Maul is an on-next-swing attack whose swing gives no Rage. Bear Form threat x1.5 (8 Oct). gs still uses the Classic damage-based bear rage, which gives about half as much.

Balance: spells 1.5 s GCD (hasted to a 1.0 s floor). Wrath (filler, 2.0 s, 1.5 s with Improved Wrath 5/5) grants 2 Eclipse charges; each charge takes 0.5 s off one Starfire (3.5 s, 3.0 s with Improved Starfire). Keep Insect Swarm and Moonfire up. Nature's Grace: any non-periodic spell crit gives +10% cast speed and -10% GCD for 3 s. DoT ticks can crit.

Omen of Clarity is baseline at level 20 for every druid: a Clearcasting proc (10 s internal cooldown, 15 s, one charge) makes the next costed ability free (not Wrath, not free abilities). Proc rate is the biggest open number: fs 2 procs per minute from beta logs (about 4% per cat swing, 8% per bear swing), gs a literal 100% after the cooldown. Moonkin Form doubles the chance.

baseStatsLevel60.note: Classic level-60 druid base. Base mana 1244 is what every "% of base mana" cost uses: 55% = 684 (Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, Shifting Power), 35% = 435 (Moonkin Form), 5% = 62 (Innervate). miao.tips quotes the same 684.

raceOffsets.note: Druid races in Forever: Night Elf and High Order (Alliance), Tauren and Windshaper (Horde). Tauren also get +5% health (Endurance), Night Elves Elune's Light (+10% crit for 15 s, 3 min).

apPerAgilityInCat.note: Cat Form tooltip: "increasing Attack Power by 12 plus Agility". Bear and caster get no AP from Agility.

gearHitAndCritShared.note: Forever pays the hit and crit printed on gear into both the melee and the spell pool. Rating: 14 per 1% at 60. Attribute conversions (Agility, Intellect) stay separate.

weaponSkill.note: Forms use the level-based skill (300). No weapon-skill gear matters.

armor.note: Classic boss armor, same dummy as the rogue and warrior sheets. Faerie Fire takes 505 off (3226).

target.stunImmunityNote: Not modelled by the sims. Raid bosses are normally immune to stuns and roots, so Bash, the Pounce stun and the Feral Charge root are cosmetic on a boss dummy; decide per dummy.

catAbilities.note: Every Cat Form attack row has GCDMs 1000 (Shred, Claw, Rake, Rip, Ferocious Bite, Ravage, Pounce, Cower). Not reduced by haste (physical school, IgnoreHaste in both sims).

bearAbilities.note: Swipe, Primal Bite, Lacerate, Demoralizing Roar, Bash, Challenging Roar, Frenzied Regeneration: GCDMs 1500, not hasted. Maul is on next swing (no GCD).

spells.note: Balance spells, Faerie Fire, Innervate, Barkskin, Moonkin Form. In Forever, non-physical spell GCDs scale with casting haste down to a 1.0 s floor (sim-provisional, as in the rogue/warrior sheets). Nature's Grace also takes 10% off.

shapeshift.note: Cat Form, Dire Bear Form and Moonkin Form trigger a 1.5 s GCD that haste does not shorten. Leaving a form (clicking it again) is off the GCD and free in the sims.

faerieFireInCat.note: Cat Form (Passive) 3025 takes 0.5 s off Faerie Fire's 1.5 s GCD. gs does not apply it (1.5 s).

attackTable.inheritedFromRogueSheet: Same level-63 table as research/rogue_forever.json for Cat and Bear attacks (single weapon, no dual-wield penalty): 8% special and white miss (sims 9%), 6.5% dodge, 14% parry and 5% block only from the front, 40% glancing on white hits only, crit minus 4.8%. Measured on the beta (magey #1).

specialMiss.note: No hit suppression in game, so the special hit cap is 8%. Both sims still use 9%.

whiteMiss.note: Forms never dual wield, so white hits use the same 8%.

attackTable.catBehindTarget: A cat attacks from behind: no parry, no block. Shred and Ravage require it. Claw works from any side.
attackTable.bearInFront: A tanking bear attacks from the front: the boss parries 14% and blocks 5% of its attacks, and each boss parry speeds up the boss's next swing.

critMultiplier.note: Natural Instinct (ex-Predatory Instincts) +10/20% crit damage bonus on melee abilities, not on white hits.

missVsPlus3.note: Base 17% vs a level-63 target; spell hit lowers it to a 1% floor, so the cap is +16% spell hit. Gear hit counts (shared pool); Nature's Reach +2/4%.

critSuppression.note: gs does not subtract spell crit against +3 targets (the suppression line is commented out). No Forever measurement.

partialResists.value: average 6% damage reduction on non-binary spells vs +3 (2% per level), no resist on binary spells
partialResists.note: Wrath, Starfire and Moonfire roll 0/25/50/75% partial resists (about 82% full, 13% 25%, 4% 50%, 1% 75%). Insect Swarm and Hurricane are binary (all or nothing, no partials) on a 0-resistance target.

spellCritMultiplier.note: Vengeance: +20% per point to the crit damage bonus of Arcane and Nature spells (bonus 50% -> 100%).

formula.note: Verified on the beta (warrior sheet). 3731 armor = 40.4% mitigation; 3226 with Faerie Fire = 37.0%.

bleedsIgnoreArmor.note: Rake and Rip ticks, Lacerate, Pounce bleed. miao.tips also says bleeds ignore armor.

faerieFire.note: Rank 4 (9907): -505 armor for 40 s. Faerie Fire (Feral) is gone in Forever; the normal Faerie Fire is castable in Cat, Bear and Moonkin. miao.tips quotes the same -505.

ticksCanCrit.note: Client flag PERIODIC_CAN_CRIT is set on Rake, Rip, Pounce Bleed, Lacerate, Moonfire and Insect Swarm. Bleeds crit with melee crit (x2.0, Natural Instinct does not apply to ticks in gs), Moonfire/Insect Swarm ticks with spell crit (x1.5, x2.0 with Vengeance). gs rolls every periodic tick against the current crit chance.

dynamicTicks.note: Forever ticks re-read attack power and modifiers every tick (rogue sheet: confirmed). Rip's AP share is recalculated each tick; the combo points are fixed at cast.

regen.note: PowerType: 10/s. Beta players (rogue and feral threads) report smooth regeneration: model it as continuous (gs: 1 Energy per 100 ms). Haste scaling is unverified (rogue sheet).

refundOnAvoid.note: Client flag DISCOUNT_POWER_ON_MISS is on Shred, Claw, Rake, Ravage, Pounce, Cower, Rip, Ferocious Bite (and bear Maul, Lacerate, Primal Bite, Bash), not on Swipe. The 80% figure is the Classic rule. gs refunds 80% on builders and 0% on Rip and Ferocious Bite; fs refunds 80% on all flagged attacks. miao.tips also uses 80%.

rules.mana: See balance.mana. Cat and Bear keep their mana bar for shapeshifts, Shifting Power and Faerie Fire; mana regenerates in every form (fs suppresses part of Spirit regen in animal forms, gs does not).

moonkinAndCaster.note: Subtlety (Resto) lowers Nature/Arcane spell threat by 10% per point.

disarmImmune.note: 1 Oct: all shapeshift forms are immune to Disarm (a disarm applied before shifting still lowers damage).

tanking.summary: A bear can be practiced on a dummy only if the dummy hits back: about half of the bear's Rage comes from being hit (damage taken, Natural Reaction dodges, Blood Frenzy crits come from both sides), and Frenzied Regeneration/Barkskin need incoming damage. Unlike the warrior there is no block or parry, so the loop is simpler: Primal Bite on cooldown, Lacerate to 5 stacks and refresh, keep Demoralizing Roar and Faerie Fire up, Maul with spare Rage.

differencesFromWarriorDummy.value: No parry and no block for the bear: the boss's table vs a bear is miss 4.4% (+0.04% per Defense above 300), dodge (bear dodge - 0.6%), crit 5.6% (-0.04% per Defense), crushing 15%, hit. Crushing blows are never pushed off the table (that would need miss + dodge + crit >= 85%).
No parry haste caused by the bear (it cannot parry). The boss still parries 14% of the bear's frontal attacks and those parries haste the boss's next swing.
Mitigation: armor A/(A+5755) is the bear's main defense (Dire Bear x4.6 item armor); Barkskin x0.8 physical; no Shield Block/Shield Wall equivalents; Frenzied Regeneration turns Rage into health.
Reactions on each boss swing: incoming Rage (~6.2 normal / 12.4 crit / 9.3 crushing), Natural Reaction (5 Rage on dodge at 5/5), Omen of Clarity can proc from the bear's own hits only.
No crit immunity talent (no Survival of the Fittest in Classic or Forever): the bear takes the boss's 5.6% crits unless it reaches 440 Defense.

openQuestions: Omen of Clarity proc rate: 2 PPM on form/cast speed (fs, from logs; forever-bugs #220 implies a speed-based chance) or 100% after the 10 s cooldown (gs literal)? Does Moonkin also halve the cooldown (fs) or only double the chance (Blizzard text)?

Bear outgoing Rage at level 60: is it still 11.25 per swing (3.46 x 2.5 x 1.3)? Is the 8 Oct crit bonus +100% of 11.25 (22.5 total) or of the base 8.65 (19.9)? Do dodged/parried bear swings give 0 like the warrior's?
Incoming Rage coefficient after 8 Oct (shared with the warrior sheet): ~6.2 per boss hit is a reading of Blizzard's text, not a measurement.

Rake and AP: the deep dive says Rake "now gains increased damage from Attack Power", but the client row has no AP term and both sims use flat damage. Does Rake's initial hit ignore armor (gs, miao.tips) or not (fs)?
AP shares not in the client: Rip 1% AP per CP per tick (cap 4 CP), Ferocious Bite 3% AP per CP (Classic values in both sims).
Do Rip and Ferocious Bite refund 80% when avoided (fs, client flag) or nothing (gs)?
Faerie Fire in Cat Form: 1.0 s GCD (client passive) or 1.5 s (24 Sep report)? Its threat is 0 in forms today (bug); the 6 s cooldown carries into caster form (bug #307).
Shifting Power: does it start the five-second rule, and can Clearcasting make it free (players: yes / no)? Exact level-60 cost with Natural Shapeshifter (479?).
Does haste speed up Energy regeneration? Does Nature's Grace's -10% GCD stack with haste-based GCD scaling (DRU-008)?
Form weapon damage range: gs scales the weapon's min-max to the form speed; Blizzard only states DPS. Is the paw's variance the weapon's?
Launch availability of Ferocious Bite rank 5 and Starfire rank 7 (AQ-era books in Classic). Fallbacks: Bite rank 4 (45-95 + 128/CP, 2.5 per Energy), Starfire rank 6 (313-370, 315 mana).

Threat coefficients: Primal Bite (x3 gs / x1.5 fs), Lacerate x3.33, Swipe x2, Maul x1.75, Demoralizing Roar per target. Only the 1.5 form multiplier is sourced. Resource threat looks lower than 5 per Rage in game (forever-bugs #278).
Mana regeneration: Spirit formula for druids at 60 (gs uses 6.25 + Spi/8 per second); MP5 currently pays per second on the beta (bug #54).
Spell crit suppression vs +3 (gs: none) and level-based partial resists (gs: 6% average) are Classic assumptions.
Wowhead's "Level 60" tooltips scale to the rank's maximum level (Dire Bear 210 AP / 1560 health, Starfire 364-426). Which value does a level-60 druid really get (sims: 180 / 1240, 350-412)?
Lacerate direct hit: 10% weapon damage per stack before (gs) or after the new application? Any hidden AP term?
Is Pounce/Ravage (once per pull) worth modelling on an endless dummy? gs omits both; fs has Ravage only.
Omen ICD in Moonkin and the low-rank proc penalty (1 Oct) need numbers.
Feral Charge (Cat) cost (not shown on Wowhead) and the open bug that puts the bear charge on 30 s.
